confidence_boundary: Human versus AI control is confirmed from the participant-owned controller pointer and the gameplay paths that branch on its presence. The remapped participant byte at +0xF2 remains a team/slot identity and is not promoted to a human/AI flag. Internal fields of the AI controller object are not part of the stable System 2.0 context contract.

field.ai_encoding: non-null pointer to the 0x90-byte AI controller object
field.name: ai_controller_pointer

functions.evidence: Stores the participant index at +0xF0, clears +0xC8, chooses a human-controlled prefix length of one in ordinary local modes, replaces that prefix length with the ARM9 active-slot count in modes 6 and 7, and allocates the AI controller only when participant_index is not inside that human prefix.
functions.name: initialize_participant_control_identity

functions.evidence: Checks four multiplayer slot entries through helper 0x02011968 and returns the number of active entries. The participant constructor uses this result only in game modes 6 and 7 as the count of participants that must not receive AI controllers.
functions.name: count_active_multiplayer_participant_slots

functions.evidence: Initializes the 0x90-byte object stored at participant +0xC8 with the owning participant index at object +0x79 and AI decision state used by later planning functions.
functions.name: construct_ai_controller

functions.evidence: Selects the active participant object and treats a non-null +0xC8 pointer as the AI path before entering AI-specific battle setup.
functions.name: branch_on_active_participant_ai_control

functions.evidence: Loads the active participant's +0xC8 pointer, returns immediately when it is null, and otherwise consumes the pointed-to decision state to generate the AI-controlled shot.
functions.name: run_ai_shot_planner

functions.evidence: Calls AI-controller reset helper 0x02231038 only when +0xC8 is non-null. The participant identity pointer itself is preserved.
functions.name: reset_ai_controller_state

functions.evidence: Destroys the object referenced by participant +0xC8 when non-null; the deleting destructor then releases the participant object. No identity transfer occurs.
functions.name: destroy_participant_and_ai_controller

lifecycle.initialization: The participant constructor first clears +0xC8. Participants within the human-controlled prefix retain null. Every later participant receives a newly allocated AI controller.
lifecycle.lifetime: The pointer is participant-owned and stable for the participant object's session lifetime. AI state resets do not change the pointer.
mutations: 0x0226982C stores the constructed AI controller for AI-controlled participants.
No later participant-rooted assignment to +0xC8 was found; gameplay paths only test or consume it.
lifecycle.reset: 0x0226A014 invokes the AI-controller state reset when the pointer is non-null. Final reset occurs by destruction with the participant object.

runtime_cross_check.result: The clean tutorial/story control uses an ordinary non-network mode. The constructor's fixed human prefix length of one therefore predicts participant 0 as null/human and participant 1 as non-null/AI, matching the independently observed player/opponent roles.

scripted_and_multiplayer_behavior.multiplayer: Modes 6 and 7 replace the fixed one-human prefix with the active multiplayer-slot count returned by 0x0202F134. Human participants remain null-controlled; participants after that prefix receive AI controllers.
scripted_and_multiplayer_behavior.scripted: The tutorial/story runtime control follows the same participant constructor and local one-human cutoff. No later tutorial or scripted write that changes participant +0xC8 was found.

supported_conclusions: participant +0xC8 is the authoritative human/AI control representation.
A null +0xC8 pointer identifies a human-controlled participant.
A non-null +0xC8 pointer identifies an AI-controlled participant.
The identity is independent of Gate ownership, challenger/defender ordering, and participant +0xF2 team/slot remapping.
System 2.0 can derive human_ai_identity as a boolean from +0xC8 without depending on AI-controller internals.

system2_context_contract.safety: Read only while the participant object is live. Do not persist or dereference the controller pointer from Gate data.
